questions.question: The equation 2Cu + O₂ → 2CuO is an example of a ________ reaction.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 4**__ i.e __**combination**__.

__
 
• **Displacement reaction**:

 
 
• In these reactions, an atom/ion present in a compound gets replaced by an atom/ion of another element.
 
• Example: FeSO₄ + Zn → ZnSO₄ + Fe
 
 
 
• **Decomposition reaction**:
 
 
• In these reactions, compound either of its own or upon heating decomposes to given two or more components out of which at least one is in the elemental state. 
 
• Example: 2NaH → Na + H₂​
 
 
 
• **Combination reaction**__:
 
 
• In these reactions, compounds are formed as a result of the chemical combination of two or more elements.
 
• Examples:
 
• C + O₂ → CO₂ 
 
• **2Cu + O2 → 2CuO**
 
 
 
• **Double displacement reaction**:
 
 
• In these reactions, two compounds exchange ions to form two new compounds.
 
• Example: Na₂S + 2HCL → 2NaCl + H₂S

questions.question: What is the area (in m²) of a triangular field whose sides measure 25 m, 39 m and 56 m?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a scalene triangle, the area can be calculated directly using Heron's formula.

Semi-perimeter (s) = (25 + 39 + 56) ÷ 2 = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 m.

Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area = √[60 × (60 − 25) × (60 − 39) × (60 − 56)]

Area = √[60 × 35 × 21 × 4] = √[176400] = 420 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 420 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangular field:

a = 25 m

b = 39 m

c = 56 m

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula for the area of a triangle:

Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

Where, semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523f1946debf8239eebd6391ac53cf962bd6ce1194f2d2db325a30f519ba22af.png]

⇒ s = (25 + 39 + 56) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 m

⇒ Area = √[60 × (60 − 25) × (60 − 39) × (60 − 56)]

⇒ Area = √[60 × 35 × 21 × 4]

⇒ Area = √[(15 × 4) × (7 × 5) × (7 × 3) × 4]

Grouping the similar terms to find square roots:

⇒ Area = √[(4 × 4) × (7 × 7) × (15 × 5 × 3)]

⇒ Area = √[16 × 49 × 225]

⇒ Area = 4 × 7 × 15

⇒ Area = 420 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 420 m².**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

For a triangle with all three equal sides (a), Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a².

For a triangle with two equal sides (a) and a base (b), Area = (b ÷ 4) × √(4a² − b²).

questions.question: To hear distinct echoes, the minimum distance of the obstacle form the source of sound must be ______.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 1**__ i.e __**17.2 m**__.

__
 
• The sound that is heard after getting reflected from the surface is called as **Echo**.
 
• As the sensation of sound persists in our brain for about **0.1 s**, to hear a distinct echo the time interval between the reflected sound and the original sound must be at least 0.1s. 
 
• If we take the speed of sound to be 344 m/s at a given temperature in air
 
• Hence, the total distance covered by the sound from the point of source to the reflecting surface and back should be at least (344 m/s) × 0.1 s = 34.4 m.
 
• Thus, to hear distinct echoes**, the minimum distance of the obstacle from the source of sound **must be half of this distance** i.e 34.4/2 i.e 17.2 m__.**
 
• This distance will change with the temperature of the air.
